constraints: If encoded is omitted, the command overwrites toEncode in place with the encoded value instead of writing to a separate parameter.
Base64URL (selected via the trailing *) is an alternate encoding with URL/filename-safe substitutions per RFC 4648, distinct from standard Base64.

overloadMerges.note: toEncode is documented/arrow-marked as inout ('<->': input raw value, and also the output slot when encoded is omitted); encoded is a pure output. The draft parser had defaulted every parameter to direction:in.

params.name: toEncode
params.description: Raw value to encode; overwritten in place with the encoded value if encoded is omitted.

params.name: encoded
params.description: Receives the encoded value, if supplied.
If present, encode using the Base64URL variant instead of standard Base64.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Encodes toEncode as Base64/Base64URL, either into encoded or back into toEncode itself if encoded is omitted.
